item.title: GenAI-Powered IVR for Claims Automation
item.description:
Built a Generative AI-powered interactive voice response system at Asurion that automates insurance claims processing from intake through resolution.

The system uses fine-tuned LLMs and NLP to understand customer intent, classify claim types, and route or resolve without human intervention. Designed for multi-tenant SaaS deployment, it now serves enterprise clients including Amazon and McAfee.

Impact: $5-10M in annual operating cost reduction.

Tech: LLM fine-tuning (LoRA), NLP, multi-tenant SaaS architecture, real-time inference

item.title: AI Evaluation and Feedback System
item.description:
Designed and built an evaluation framework for Asurion’s IVR and other production AI systems.

The system captures live interaction data, scores model outputs against quality benchmarks, and feeds structured signals back into the training pipeline. Instead of periodic manual reviews, the framework creates a closed loop where production performance data directly informs retraining priorities.

This lets the team catch degradation patterns early, measure the impact of model updates before full rollout, and systematically improve AI quality over time. The system is generalizable across any AI-powered workflow, not just the IVR.

item.title: NER-Based Auto-Triage for Field Services
item.description:
Built an NLP system at Asurion that automatically triages major appliance repair requests using Named Entity Recognition.

The model extracts product details, symptom descriptions, and fault indicators from customer intake data, then classifies the issue and recommends the right repair path. Before this system, every request required manual expert review.

Impact:

  • 10% of triage decisions fully automated
  • First-trip-fix rate improved by 10%
  • 5,900+ expert-assist hours saved per year
  • $150K+ annual savings across 17 markets

Tech: NER, NLP pipelines, production deployment, multi-market rollout

item.title: Geospatial Optimization and Smart Scheduling
item.description:
Designed optimization models at Asurion for field technician routing and job scheduling.

The system uses geospatial data to minimize drive time between service appointments, clusters nearby jobs to create efficient daily routes, and dynamically adjusts schedules based on real-time demand. Also replaced manual Excel-based demand planning with automated time-series forecasting.

Impact:

  • Drive time reduced by 30% (9 min/job)
  • 1.1 additional jobs per technician per day
  • $1-1.5M in annual cost savings
  • Eliminated manual Excel-based planning workflows

Tech: Geospatial optimization, clustering algorithms, time-series forecasting, Python

item.title: ML-Powered Medical Diagnostics (FDA Class II)
item.description:
Built the core data science pipeline for a point-of-care colorimetric diagnostic device at HueDx (Group K Diagnostics).

The system uses smartphone imaging and machine learning to quantify biomarker concentrations from paper-based microfluidic test strips. The image processing pipeline (OpenCV) handles noise removal, boundary detection, and morphological shape analysis. ML models convert color intensity readings into analyte concentrations for liver, renal, metabolic, and cardiac markers.

Designed to work without lab infrastructure in resource-limited clinical settings. All development followed FDA 510(k) regulatory constraints.
